title: Read your first tab line
summary: One line chooses the string; one number chooses the fret.

steps.title: Read your first tab line
steps.body:
**tab** means a guitar playing picture with six lines and numbers telling you which places to play

**Why it matters:** It tells you a string and a fret without needing music notation.

The top line is thin string 1; the bottom line is thick string 6. Read left to right. A number on a line tells the fret: 0 means open, 1 means the first fret. The small example below says: play open string 6, then its first fret. A fretboard picture uses the same string numbers but draws the places as circles.

steps.title: Look and listen
steps.body: Find the bottom line labelled 6 E. Read its 0, then its 1 from left to right. Find those same two places on the fretboard. Nothing here tells you how fast to play yet.

items.prompt: Play the lit note. Tap it here, or play one string with the microphone.

steps.title: Take your time
steps.body: Read the tab aloud: string 6 open, then string 6 fret 1. Play slowly or tap the circles. Go back to the picture whenever you need.

items.prompt: In guitar tab, what does 0 mean?
